# Broad Peak Adventures - Full Documentation

> Complete guide, technical architecture, expedition index, and travel specifications for Broad Peak Adventures.

## Company Overview

Broad Peak Adventures is a fully registered, licensed mountaineering and trekking organization operating out of Skardu, Gilgit-Baltistan, Pakistan. The organization provides complete logistical, permit, and guide support for mountaineering expeditions across the Karakoram, Himalaya, and Hindu Kush ranges.

## Expeditions & Pricing Index

- [K2 Base Camp & Concordia Trek](https://tourism-eight-pearl-vercel-app.vercel.app/expedition-detail?id=k2): 21 Days | Extreme | 5,585m Max Alt | June - August | $2,850/person
- [Attabad Lake & Hunza Explorer](https://tourism-eight-pearl-vercel-app.vercel.app/expedition-detail?id=attabad-lake): 7 Days | Moderate | 2,500m Max Alt | April - October | $1,200/person
- [Fairy Meadows & Nanga Parbat](https://tourism-eight-pearl-vercel-app.vercel.app/expedition-detail?id=fairy-meadows): 8 Days | Moderate-Hard | 3,300m Max Alt | May - September | $1,150/person
- [Deosai Plains & Skardu Valley](https://tourism-eight-pearl-vercel-app.vercel.app/expedition-detail?id=deosai-sunrise): 6 Days | Easy-Moderate | 4,114m Max Alt | June - September | $980/person

## Web Application Navigation & Endpoints

- [Home](https://tourism-eight-pearl-vercel-app.vercel.app/): Home Page & Featured Expeditions
- [Expeditions Catalog](https://tourism-eight-pearl-vercel-app.vercel.app/expeditions): Full List of Available Expeditions
- [Blog & Articles](https://tourism-eight-pearl-vercel-app.vercel.app/blog): Mountain Travel Insights & Packing Guides
- [Travel Guides](https://tourism-eight-pearl-vercel-app.vercel.app/travel-guides): In-Depth Region Guides (Hunza, Skardu, Fairy Meadows)
- [About Us](https://tourism-eight-pearl-vercel-app.vercel.app/about): Agency History, Safety Commitment, and Team Info
- [Contact Form](https://tourism-eight-pearl-vercel-app.vercel.app/contact): Booking Inquiry Form with n8n Webhook Integration
- [FAQ](https://tourism-eight-pearl-vercel-app.vercel.app/faq): Frequently Asked Questions
- [Privacy Policy](https://tourism-eight-pearl-vercel-app.vercel.app/privacy): Data Privacy Policy
- [Terms & Conditions](https://tourism-eight-pearl-vercel-app.vercel.app/terms): Terms & Conditions

## Technical Architecture

- SPA built with React 19, Vite, TypeScript, and modular Vanilla CSS.
- Asynchronous non-blocking n8n webhook API endpoints for inquiry dispatch and newsletter processing.
- Core Web Vitals optimized, zero render-blocking CSS, pre-compressed WebP media assets.
